test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence:

(A) the guests

(B) arrived

(C) at the party

(D) early
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)**, i.e**. ABDC.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence begins with the action "the guests" which is correctly indicated by **part (A).**
 
• Following the action, "arrived," **(B)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear who arrived.
 
• **The next part,** "early" adds information about when the guests arrived.**(D).**
 
• **Ending with** "at the party,"** (C) **completes the sentence by describing where the guests arrived.

Therefore, the correct answer is ABDC.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1 (****BACD****):** This option starts with "arrived the guests early at the party," which is grammatically awkward and disrupts the natural flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (BADC):** This option starts with "arrived the guests early at the party," which is grammatically incorrect and does not make sense.
 
• **Option 4 (CBAD):** This option starts with "at the party arrived the guests early," which creates a fragmented and confusing sentence structure.
